taxon.  Lowercase it is a species, with varieties, but none
of the varieties are called ventricosus.

notes:
Actinia (Pallas 1766) was a genus of holothuroideans,
while Actinia (Linnaeus 1767) is a genus of corals.
Lamarck seems to have conflated them, along with
a smattering of priapulids, here.  Since this genus
is grouped with Holothuria (Linnaeus 1767) and
Fistularia (Forsskål 1775), it is treated nas
Actinia (Pallas 1766).
